convertibility_reason: Complex adaptive impulse detection logic with session-based parameter adjustments, Fibonacci decay analysis, multi-condition entry gauntlet, and smart trailing system. Uses CTrade/CHistoryOrderInfo standard library but has intricate state machine logic (SImpulseState) and adaptive thresholds that require careful porting. No custom iCustom indicators, but the multi-layered adaptive logic and commented-out alternative implementations indicate non-trivial conversion effort.

indicators.name: Long-term ATR for Session Volatility Check

derived_values.name: Adaptive Body Ratio
derived_values.formula: InpMinBodyRatio * 0.8 (high vol ATR%) or * 1.2 (low vol ATR%)

derived_values.name: Fibonacci 61.8% Decay Level
derived_values.formula: bullish: detection_price - (detection_price - impulse_open) * 0.618; bearish: detection_price + (impulse_open - detection_price) * 0.618

other_exits: Impulse decay triggers ResetImpulse() which clears state but does not close existing positions
Fibonacci 61.8% retracement invalidation of impulse state
Volume decay below 25% of original impulse volume ratio invalidates impulse state
Duration exceeded (expected_bars + 2 tolerance) invalidates impulse state

position_sizing.conditional_logic: If InpReduceAfterLoss is true, risk is multiplied by (1 - InpReductionFactor) after a losing trade. Min equity and margin level checks gate all trading.

custom_logic_notes: Core logic is an impulse detection state machine (SImpulseState struct). Entry requires ALL of: (1) tick_volume >= avg_volume * adaptive_volume_multiplier, (2) body_ratio >= adaptive_body_ratio, (3) close_position >= InpClosePosition (relaxed if body_ratio > 0.8), (4) range_ratio >= 1.05 (range expansion vs previous bar), (5) trend confirmation via MA50 position + slope. Adaptive parameters adjust based on session (Asian/London/NY/Pacific) and volatility. IsGoodTradingSession uses a '80% rule' comparing short-term ATR(20) vs long-term ATR(100) - session is valid only if current ATR >= 80% of long-term ATR. Asian/Pacific sessions require ATR >= 120% of long-term to allow trading. CheckTradingConditions has redundant spread/session checks at lines 807-810 (checks same conditions already checked earlier in the function). The EA has extensive commented-out alternative implementations (3 versions of ProcessNewBar, 3 versions of IsImpulseDecayed) indicating iterative development. Trailing runs on every tick (not just new bar) for real-time responsiveness. Session classification uses broker server time (TimeCurrent) not local time. Position gate: no explicit check for existing same-direction positions in entry logic - relies on impulse state reset after trade execution to prevent double entry.
python_conversion_notes: 1) The adaptive threshold system (session-based multiplier adjustments for volume, body ratio, spread) must be faithfully replicated. 2) The impulse state machine with SImpulseState struct needs explicit state tracking - not just indicator comparisons. 3) ATR(100) is created inside IsGoodTradingSession() on every call - in Python, cache this handle/buffer to avoid recomputation. 4) The redundant spread/session checks in CheckTradingConditions (lines 807-810) should be preserved or intentionally removed based on user preference. 5) Trailing stop logic runs every tick - in Python backtesting with bar data, trailing will only evaluate at bar close which may underperform vs live. 6) Position gate is implicit via impulse state reset - verify no duplicate entries can occur. 7) Fibonacci 61.8% decay level uses iOpen at Impulse.start_bar index which changes as start_bar increments - ensure bar indexing is correctly mapped in Python. 8) Volume data uses tick_volume not real_volume - ensure data source compatibility. 9) The Session filter hour=0 rollover guard and the adaptive ATR-based session filter are independent - both must pass.
